description: HP-37 is the designated code for the Registering and Licensing Authority (RLA) based in Palampur, Kangra district. This office serves the Palampur sub-division, primarily handling the registration of non-transport vehicles and the issuance of learner and permanent driving licenses. It operates under the administration of the Sub Divisional Officer (Civil) of Palampur.
address: Office of the Sub Divisional Officer (C), Palampur, District Kangra, Himachal Pradesh
